game_title: Divide Or Floor – Obsidian Quarry Defense
game_concept: A tower defense set in Mt. Pyre – Obsidian Quarry, a glassy black quarry: the forge smith must handle smoke serpents while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Divide Or Floor: Pick / or // to split fire gems evenly among allies without leaving fractions.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Obsidian Quarry: a glassy black quarry
core_gameplay_loop: In Obsidian Quarry, repeat each round: Pick / or // to split fire gems evenly among allies without leaving fractions. Each round, smoke serpents strike the ember furnace, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the share value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the ember furnace from smoke serpents in Obsidian Quarry: keep the share meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 30-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: share drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 30-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 1 (intro tier): Divide Or Floor
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Divide Or Floor' (Week 2 slot 4), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Obsidian Quarry'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how share changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against smoke serpents in Obsidian Quarry.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 30 seconds while share > 0.
